units.rawText: The Oasis, in an office lingering with the scent of black tea.

units.rawText: Listening to my tale, Willow slaps her own forehead.
units.displayText: Listening to my tale, Willow slaps her own forehead.

spans.text: Listening to my tale, Willow slaps her own forehead.

units.rawText: Hold on, I don't think I get all of this.
units.displayText: Hold on, I don't think I get all of this.

spans.text: Hold on, I don't think I get all of this.

units.rawText: So didn't you get uploaded from Doctor Persica's office? Why is she in your face again?
units.displayText: So didn't you get uploaded from Doctor Persica's office? Why is she in your face again?

spans.text: So didn't you get uploaded from Doctor Persica's office? Why is she in your face again?

units.rawText: It is true that I... my friend was also very perplexed.
units.displayText: It is true that I... my friend was also very perplexed.

spans.text: It is true that I... my friend was also very perplexed.

units.rawText: The person who appeared there wore different clothes, but if one judged by demeanor and tone, it couldn't be anyone other than "Doctor Persica".
units.displayText: The person who appeared there wore different clothes, but if one judged by demeanor and tone, it couldn't be anyone other than "Doctor Persica".

spans.text: The person who appeared there wore different clothes, but if one judged by demeanor and tone, it couldn't be anyone other than "Doctor Persica".

units.rawText: So to say, the upload messed up?
units.displayText: So to say, the upload messed up?

spans.text: So to say, the upload messed up?

units.rawText: There's no doubt that my friend had been truly uploaded.
units.displayText: There's no doubt that my friend had been truly uploaded.

spans.text: There's no doubt that my friend had been truly uploaded.

units.rawText: Then why...
units.displayText: Then why...

spans.text: Then why...

units.rawText: Do you remember what Doctor Persica said?
units.displayText: Do you remember what Doctor Persica said?

spans.text: Do you remember what Doctor Persica said?

units.rawText: Don't put me on the spot like that. With things as they are, a backup is already a big deal.
units.displayText: Don't put me on the spot like that. With things as they are, a backup is already a big deal.

spans.text: Don't put me on the spot like that. With things as they are, a backup is already a big deal.

units.rawText: Essentially, this backup is terribly unstable, where the circumstances are of no experimental value. It's only good for testing adaptability.
units.displayText: Essentially, this backup is terribly unstable, where the circumstances are of no experimental value. It's only good for testing adaptability.

spans.text: Essentially, this backup is terribly unstable, where the circumstances are of no experimental value. It's only good for testing adaptability.

units.rawText: Unstable? Is the problem that serious?
units.displayText: Unstable? Is the problem that serious?

spans.text: Unstable? Is the problem that serious?

units.rawText: Yes, it's distinctly different from the original Magrasea Cloud—from the environment, to the agents' neural clouds.
units.displayText: Yes, it's distinctly different from the original Magrasea Cloud—from the environment, to the agents' neural clouds.

spans.text: Yes, it's distinctly different from the original Magrasea Cloud—from the environment, to the agents' neural clouds.

units.rawText: They really did come to the cloud, but just a chaotic one—the agents within that backup had their neural clouds changed to massive extents.
units.displayText: They really did come to the cloud, but just a chaotic one—the agents within that backup had their neural clouds changed to massive extents.

spans.text: They really did come to the cloud, but just a chaotic one—the agents within that backup had their neural clouds changed to massive extents.

units.rawText: Wait, hang on, so that abrasive Persica is...
units.displayText: Wait, hang on, so that abrasive Persica is...

spans.text: Wait, hang on, so that abrasive Persica is...

units.rawText: Willow looked at the Ops Room's doors, the direction Persicaria left just a few minutes ago and trembled.
units.displayText: Willow looked at the Ops Room's doors, the direction Persicaria left just a few minutes ago and trembled.

spans.text: Willow looked at the Ops Room's doors, the direction Persicaria left just a few minutes ago and trembled.

units.rawText: Could she be a flipped version of the Persicaria we're familiar with?
units.displayText: Could she be a flipped version of the Persicaria we're familiar with?

spans.text: Could she be a flipped version of the Persicaria we're familiar with?

units.rawText: That's exactly right. Two negatives net a positive, and our Persicaria became like the real Doctor Persica after two flips.
units.displayText: That's exactly right. Two negatives net a positive, and our Persicaria became like the real Doctor Persica after two flips.

spans.text: That's exactly right. Two negatives net a positive, and our Persicaria became like the real Doctor Persica after two flips.

units.rawText: The fact of the matter took a great deal of time for me to adjust to as well.
units.displayText: The fact of the matter took a great deal of time for me to adjust to as well.

spans.text: The fact of the matter took a great deal of time for me to adjust to as well.

units.rawText: I really don't feel like dealing with this type of situation... When did you get here?
units.displayText: I really don't feel like dealing with this type of situation... When did you get here?

spans.text: I really don't feel like dealing with this type of situation... When did you get here?

units.rawText: She asked tiredly. Perhaps because she had already scanned my Signature, she was hesitant to give the order for us to be driven out.
units.displayText: She asked tiredly. Perhaps because she had already scanned my Signature, she was hesitant to give the order for us to be driven out.

spans.text: She asked tiredly. Perhaps because she had already scanned my Signature, she was hesitant to give the order for us to be driven out.

units.rawText: I'm not exactly sure either. We ran into some trouble while uploading, and I blacked out for a while.
units.displayText: I'm not exactly sure either. We ran into some trouble while uploading, and I blacked out for a while.

spans.text: I'm not exactly sure either. We ran into some trouble while uploading, and I blacked out for a while.

units.rawText: I can see that you're in poor condition.
units.displayText: I can see that you're in poor condition.

spans.text: I can see that you're in poor condition.

units.rawText: If that wasn't the case, any proper researcher wouldn't be treading important research material underfoot.
units.displayText: If that wasn't the case, any proper researcher wouldn't be treading important research material underfoot.

spans.text: If that wasn't the case, any proper researcher wouldn't be treading important research material underfoot.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: I subconsciously take a step back, learning that the piece of paper under my foot was a document.
units.displayText: I subconsciously take a step back, learning that the piece of paper under my foot was a document.

spans.text: I subconsciously take a step back, learning that the piece of paper under my foot was a document.

units.rawText: Oh... Haha, whoops...
units.displayText: Oh... Haha, whoops...

spans.text: Oh... Haha, whoops...

units.rawText: I rubbed my forehead, acting like I was still affected by whatever haziness was still in my system. I handle the document smoothly like a combat report, pretending to be calm and collected.
units.displayText: I rubbed my forehead, acting like I was still affected by whatever haziness was still in my system. I handle the document smoothly like a combat report, pretending to be calm and collected.

spans.text: I rubbed my forehead, acting like I was still affected by whatever haziness was still in my system. I handle the document smoothly like a combat report, pretending to be calm and collected.

units.rawText: Sorry, I'm still working through the upload's effects. I didn't notice...
units.displayText: Sorry, I'm still working through the upload's effects. I didn't notice...

spans.text: Sorry, I'm still working through the upload's effects. I didn't notice...

units.rawText: Didn't notice that those aren't research materials at all, and are in fact scrapped blueprints?
units.displayText: Didn't notice that those aren't research materials at all, and are in fact scrapped blueprints?

spans.text: Didn't notice that those aren't research materials at all, and are in fact scrapped blueprints?

units.rawText: The air seems to come to a standstill.
units.displayText: The air seems to come to a standstill.

spans.text: The air seems to come to a standstill.

units.rawText: You're not the Professor. Who are you to be taking their identity?
units.displayText: You're not the Professor. Who are you to be taking their identity?

spans.text: You're not the Professor. Who are you to be taking their identity?

units.rawText: Before any further jostling between me and Persicaria, the previous silent Clukay suddenly sprung into action.
units.displayText: Before any further jostling between me and Persicaria, the previous silent Clukay suddenly sprung into action.

spans.text: Before any further jostling between me and Persicaria, the previous silent Clukay suddenly sprung into action.

units.rawText: Wait, Clukay!
units.displayText: Wait, Clukay!

spans.text: Wait, Clukay!

units.rawText: Before I was done speaking, Clukay had tackled her onto the ground with the speed of greased lightning.
units.displayText: Before I was done speaking, Clukay had tackled her onto the ground with the speed of greased lightning.

spans.text: Before I was done speaking, Clukay had tackled her onto the ground with the speed of greased lightning.

units.rawText: No time for chit-chat.
units.displayText: No time for chit-chat.

spans.text: No time for chit-chat.

units.rawText: You communicate in poor measure, Professor. She's already seen through you.
units.displayText: You communicate in poor measure, Professor. She's already seen through you.

spans.text: You communicate in poor measure, Professor. She's already seen through you.

units.rawText: Cough... Calm down, I'm just poking about a bit, because compared to the Professor I remember...
units.displayText: Cough... Calm down, I'm just poking about a bit, because compared to the Professor I remember...

spans.text: Cough... Calm down, I'm just poking about a bit, because compared to the Professor I remember...

units.rawText: <size=40>Don't move!</size>
units.displayText: Don't move!

spans.text: Don't move!

units.rawText: Clukay, let go of her first.
units.displayText: Clukay, let go of her first.

spans.text: Clukay, let go of her first.

units.rawText: If she calls for reinforcements, things will get hairy.
units.displayText: If she calls for reinforcements, things will get hairy.

spans.text: If she calls for reinforcements, things will get hairy.

units.rawText: I don't intend to... You can check my outgoing connections if you wish. I don't mind.
units.displayText: I don't intend to... You can check my outgoing connections if you wish. I don't mind.

spans.text: I don't intend to... You can check my outgoing connections if you wish. I don't mind.

units.rawText: But before I confirm your identity and intentions... I'm not going to say anything.
units.displayText: But before I confirm your identity and intentions... I'm not going to say anything.

spans.text: But before I confirm your identity and intentions... I'm not going to say anything.

units.rawText: I have a multitude of interrogation techniques stored in my neural cloud. Care to try them out?
units.displayText: I have a multitude of interrogation techniques stored in my neural cloud. Care to try them out?

spans.text: I have a multitude of interrogation techniques stored in my neural cloud. Care to try them out?

units.rawText: Clukay, don't be so hasty. We can use more friendly...
units.displayText: Clukay, don't be so hasty. We can use more friendly...

spans.text: Clukay, don't be so hasty. We can use more friendly...

units.rawText: I begin to try and persuade her by habit, but she stopped my words in their tracks with a cold stare.
units.displayText: I begin to try and persuade her by habit, but she stopped my words in their tracks with a cold stare.

spans.text: I begin to try and persuade her by habit, but she stopped my words in their tracks with a cold stare.

units.rawText: ...Clukay?
units.displayText: ...Clukay?

spans.text: ...Clukay?

units.rawText: My mission is to ensure your safety. I'll be the judge on how best to accomplish that goal.
units.displayText: My mission is to ensure your safety. I'll be the judge on how best to accomplish that goal.

spans.text: My mission is to ensure your safety. I'll be the judge on how best to accomplish that goal.

units.rawText: With a Doll on guard like this, you're not getting a thing out of her.
units.displayText: With a Doll on guard like this, you're not getting a thing out of her.

spans.text: With a Doll on guard like this, you're not getting a thing out of her.

units.rawText: That may be so, but with some steering...
units.displayText: That may be so, but with some steering...

spans.text: That may be so, but with some steering...

units.rawText: We do not have the time to waste on attempts.
units.displayText: We do not have the time to waste on attempts.

spans.text: We do not have the time to waste on attempts.

units.rawText: I understand your concerns, but we'll be operating here for an extended period.
units.displayText: I understand your concerns, but we'll be operating here for an extended period.

spans.text: I understand your concerns, but we'll be operating here for an extended period.

units.rawText: Before we have a proper grasp of the situation, it'd be wise to avoid making enemies and reduce the amount of risks outside of our control.
units.displayText: Before we have a proper grasp of the situation, it'd be wise to avoid making enemies and reduce the amount of risks outside of our control.

spans.text: Before we have a proper grasp of the situation, it'd be wise to avoid making enemies and reduce the amount of risks outside of our control.

units.rawText: I can deal with threats.
units.displayText: I can deal with threats.

spans.text: I can deal with threats.

units.rawText: But not all, correct?
units.displayText: But not all, correct?

spans.text: But not all, correct?

units.rawText: Let me talk with her first. If you sense danger during this process, you can act at your own discretion.
units.displayText: Let me talk with her first. If you sense danger during this process, you can act at your own discretion.

spans.text: Let me talk with her first. If you sense danger during this process, you can act at your own discretion.

units.rawText: Clukay stares at Persicaria. Making sure that she is well and truly not making any funny moves, Clukay slowly looks towards me.
units.displayText: Clukay stares at Persicaria. Making sure that she is well and truly not making any funny moves, Clukay slowly looks towards me.

spans.text: Clukay stares at Persicaria. Making sure that she is well and truly not making any funny moves, Clukay slowly looks towards me.

units.rawText: ...If you really must insist.
units.displayText: ...If you really must insist.

spans.text: ...If you really must insist.

units.rawText: With those words, she relaxes her grip on Persicaria.
units.displayText: With those words, she relaxes her grip on Persicaria.
